description: This file contains the implementation of a RecordReader for reading entire text files in Hadoop/Spark, including a class for reading individual files and a configurable wrapper for combining multiple record readers.

classes.name: Configurable
classes.description: A trait implementing Hadoop's Configurable interface, allowing setting and getting Hadoop Configuration.

classes.name: WholeTextFileRecordReader
classes.description: A RecordReader for reading entire files as key-value pairs, where key is file path and value is file content.

classes.name: ConfigurableCombineFileRecordReader
classes.description: A wrapper combining multiple RecordReaders with Hadoop Configuration passing capability.

methods.name: setConf
methods.description: Sets the Hadoop Configuration for the Configurable trait.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Retrieves the Hadoop Configuration from the Configurable trait.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns progress as a float, 1.0 if processed, otherwise 0.0.

methods.name: nextKeyValue
methods.description: Reads the next file content if not processed, updates value, and marks as processed.

methods.name: initNextRecordReader
methods.description: Initializes the next RecordReader in the combine, passing configuration if available.

methods.name: setConf
methods.description: Sets Hadoop Configuration and passes it to the current RecordReader.
